meta.title: When Procol's server is down, the approver is told to try again
gaps: Stop or block Procol's backend during the approval attempt
Log in to Asha's mailbox and open the Procol approval email
Click the email's Approve action and send the generated Action:Approve email
Observe the mailbox reply containing "Please try again in a few minutes, or take the action directly in Procol."
Verify the approval is retried and later recorded or available to act on again
Configure or verify the company's connected approval mailbox and the named two-step approval workflow
